northStar: A programmer with an existing React+Tailwind page can select a region, state intent (zh/en), see a proposal bound to a real source file, reject with no residue, or accept a structured patch that writes that file, then rewind after quit/reopen.
idPolicy: Original OD-01…OD-18 IDs stay frozen in docs/review-2026-09-07/. This round uses PR3-01…PR3-14 only. Do not renumber to fake 18/18 closed.

mapping.note: realpath jail missed dangling and parent-dir symlinks
main===null treated as always-safe; user delete vs agent modify
utf8 git show / string compare drops binary conflicts
propose/accept wrapped a fake button instead of real file diffs
accept did not check beforeClassName / baseRevision / sourceHash
versionless hydrate; client-assigned versions; status refresh riding stale body
host approve:true without a one-shot receipt; no Origin/Host/Content-Type checks
before-image/tombstones were memory-only and unbound to workspaceId
apply rollback lived in a catch block; no crash journal
freeze OD-xx; this round is PR3-01…14 plus mapping table
FlatStore parent/child maps not bidirectional; activePage unchecked

findings.title: dangling symlink escape
findings.fixDirection: Distinguish ENOENT vs dangling symlink vs perms. lstat each path component. Deny symlink/junction on managed read/write/copy/delete paths. Cover existing external, dangling, and parent-dir symlink.
findings.acceptance: N01: dangling external symlink must not create a file outside the project (PATH_JAIL). C02 existing external symlink stays rejected. C01 in-project access stays allowed.

findings.title: user delete vs Agent modify
findings.fixDirection: Three-way base/current/candidate. main===null is not always safe. BATCH_CONFLICT; keep the deletion; retain the candidate in the batch.
findings.acceptance: N02: concurrent user deletion vs Agent modify returns BATCH_CONFLICT and the file stays deleted.

findings.title: binary conflict via bytes
findings.fixDirection: Compare Buffer or content hash. Git blob read keeps raw bytes. Read failure is not absent.
findings.acceptance: N03: base 80 00 / user 81 00 / agent 82 00 → BATCH_CONFLICT; user bytes preserved.

findings.title: iframe isolation must carry trusted CSS
findings.fixDirection: Keep iframe isolation. Inject trusted project CSS/tokens/fonts into srcdoc. Accept with getComputedStyle plus screenshot.
findings.acceptance: iframe getComputedStyle matches parent for background, radius, and shadow. styleSheets in the iframe is not empty.

findings.title: propose→accept must bind real source diffs
findings.fixDirection: Selection → source node map → structured patch bound to file+baseline → preview the same patch → accept applies the same patch. Unsupported edits error. Never fake-accept a button wrapper.
findings.acceptance: On examples/programmer-page, accept writes App.tsx. Reject leaves the repo unchanged.

findings.title: stale proposal must refuse
findings.fixDirection: Accept checks beforeClassName, baseRevision, and sourceHash. Mismatch refuses.
findings.acceptance: Changing the file or className after propose makes accept fail and leaves the file untouched.

findings.title: one authoritative project runtime
findings.fixDirection: Required projectId and baseVersion exact match. Server alone assigns new versions. No versionless hydrate. Status refresh cannot let a stale body ride a new version.
findings.acceptance: Missing projectId or inexact baseVersion is rejected. Client-supplied version is ignored.

findings.title: host approval is a one-shot receipt
findings.fixDirection: Receipt bound to project/revision/diff hash with TTL+consume. Raw /api/tool with approve:true and no receipt is DENIED. Origin/Host/Content-Type checks. Wire the DSH host approval channel. Do not paper over with autoApprove.
findings.acceptance: Host approve:true without a receipt is denied. A consumed receipt cannot be reused.

findings.title: HTML/JSX serialization is not visual proof
findings.fixDirection: html-render and jsx-svg always visualProof=false unless a real browser screenshot is attached.
findings.acceptance: take_screenshot html-render returns visualProof false and does not unlock a mutated claim.

findings.title: persist before-image/tombstones
findings.fixDirection: Write before-images and tombstones before authorized writes. Bind workspaceId. Survive restart across batches.
findings.acceptance: A new service on the same projectRoot can rewind a write that happened before process exit.

findings.title: durable apply transaction log
findings.fixDirection: Journal planned writes and backups on disk. Crash/SIGKILL recovery or an explicit blocked-recovery state. Memory-only catch rollback is not enough.
findings.acceptance: Replaying a leftover applying journal restores earlier files.

findings.title: freeze original OD-xx IDs
findings.fixDirection: Keep docs/review-2026-09-07 OD-01…OD-18. This round is PR3-01…14. Mapping table only. Never renumber to fake 18/18 closed.
findings.acceptance: BACKLOG_PR3.json contains mapping[] and findings PR3-01…PR3-14. Original BACKLOG.json is unchanged.

findings.title: FlatStore bidirectional parent/child
findings.fixDirection: childrenByParent and parentByChild stay inverses. Single parent. activePageId must name a page that exists.
findings.acceptance: Hydrating a child with two parents fails. setActivePage of a missing page fails.

findings.title: autosave ack must match the local edit
findings.fixDirection: Clear dirty only when localEditId and ackRevision match. Serialize saves.
findings.acceptance: A stale autosave ack leaves dirty true. Overlapping saves do not drop a newer edit.
